notes: SPEC §6.3. English only (ADR-007). Plain words for low literacy.

response_cards.title: Readings outside the safe limits
actions: Check the tester calibration and test again.
If the result is the same, tell people to boil or treat the water, or use another source.
Inform the VHT and the LC1 chairperson.
response_cards.report_note: Report within 48 hours and ask for laboratory confirmation.

response_cards.title: Sudden change from this source's usual readings
actions: Check around the source for latrines, waste, flooding or mining.
response_cards.report_note: Test this source more often until readings settle.

response_cards.title: E. coli found
actions: Tell people not to drink this water without boiling or treating it.
